name: chronicles-of-aethelgard
description: Chronicles of Aethelgard: A Modular 50k+ LOC 2D/Isometric Action-RPG & Strategy Engine

scripts.count-loc: python -c "import os; total=sum(len(open(os.path.join(r,f), encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore').readlines()) for r,d,files in os.walk('.') if not any(p in r for p in ['.git','__pycache__','node_modules']) for f in files if f.endswith(('.js','.py','.html','.css','.md','.json','.yml'))); print(f'Total Codebase LOC: {total}')"

author: Chronicles of Aethelgard Development Team
